The refined triclinic cell is supported by 42 isolated reflections with about 0.0017 degrees 2theta RMS error, the selected wallisite framework accounts for every observed peak above intensity 5 within 0.03 degrees, and the reported whole-profile correlation is about 0.992 (although no comparable external Rwp was supplied). The exact-composition wallisite topology gives chemically plausible density and Cu-S, As-S, Pb-S, and Tl-S environments. Support is strongest for the cell, Z=2, and average framework; Pb/Tl ordering and centrosymmetry are only weakly discriminated because Pb and Tl scatter nearly identically. Crucially, that discrete ambiguity was not collapsed into an averaged model: the two P-1 site assignments and the two symmetry-distinct P1 assignments (with their inversion-equivalent complements) are all instantiated as explicit, fully occupied CIFs. No strong unindexed peaks or other evidence motivates a different framework, supercell, occupancy model, or coordinate realization likely to improve the candidate set materially.
